candidates.change_summary: Delete the owner check require statement so anyone can call sendTo.
Delete the non-zero receiver check so funds can be sent to address(0), causing transfer to fail/revert.
Delete the amount>0 check so zero-amount transfers can be attempted, which may change behavior observable via events/gas or revert conditions.
Change owner check to always true, letting anyone call sendTo and change contract balance.
Change owner check to require msg.sender != owner, blocking the actual owner from using sendTo.
Change non-zero receiver check to require receiver == address(0), making the function only send to zero address (failing) and blocking normal recipients.
Change amount>0 to amount>=0, allowing zero-amount transfers (which may or may not revert on transfer).
Replace the receiver in transfer with msg.sender so funds are not sent to the intended receiver, observable via balance changes.
